description:
Start with a finished document, not a blank template. Your AI turns existing names, dates, amounts and other text in a PDF or Word document into reusable fields, preserving the rest. Tell it what should change, customize the proposed fields, then generate the next document with new values. No need to blank out text or place every field by hand.

Reuse your own letters, forms and agreements. Tell DocJig what changes and what stays fixed, review the prepared template, then create the next document with new names, dates, amounts and other details. Existing fillable PDFs retain their native form controls. Revise wording, compare samples and download completed documents from the same workflow.

Prepare documents for recipient signatures, authorize invitations to named recipients, track signing status, and retrieve completed signed PDFs and signing records. Upload a one-off document for signing or start from a reusable template. Recipients review and sign personally; you control finalization and sending.

A DocJig account is required. Word documents convert to PDF for review. Use text-based PDFs or supported fillable forms; image-only scans need conversion to a supported document first.

defaultPrompt: Turn this PDF into a reusable template for names, dates, and other details.
Fill out my PDF form. Ask me for any missing information.
Create a new document from one of my saved templates.
